column1: # The rules the gate refuses, one a line, family by family: the ID, the short
# name, whether maestro-quality.toml may excuse a finding (exception or none),
# and what the rule holds, in one line. Four fields, separated by tabs. A rule
# joins the gate by joining this list; `rust-gate gate-rules` prints it, `just
# docs` indexes it in docs/ci.md and the organization's page renders it.

column4: No import cycle between the files of one crate
A `mod.rs` or library root holds only `mod` and `use` declarations
No path from outside walks past a name its door re-exports
No import against the layers a target declares
A door offers nothing that a single outside module alone uses
A binary root holds declarations and a `fn main` of 25 lines at most
No `#[path]` attribute and no `include!` of Rust source
At most 100 lines, complexity 15, five arguments and four levels of nesting
At most 500 lines of code; past 300 it is reported
At most 100 columns, strings and comments included
Lowercase kebab-case; a publishable crate starts with `maestro-`
A test says what it proves in four words or more, with no `test_` prefix
Lowercase kebab-case, naming what it adds: no `use-`/`with-`/`enable-`/`has-`/`feature-` prefix
A `maestro-` package reads only `MAESTRO_` variables and the platform's
Every Rust file opens with a `//!` comment
Every crate denies the organization's lint list; `clippy.toml` is no looser
No print macro in a library
A library depends on no `anyhow`, `eyre` or `color-eyre`
A test waits on a fake clock or a synchronisation primitive, never on `sleep`
Integration tests build as one crate
Nothing is retried: a flaky test fails
Members inherit lints, edition, MSRV, licence and dependencies
Edition 2024, resolver 3 and a committed `Cargo.lock`
Three functions of one shape fail; extract what they share
A `TODO` or `FIXME` names its issue
No `*.snap.new` or `*.pending-snap` committed
No file over 500 KB
Shebangs match the executable bit; no case clash, no broken symlink
A `README.md` and a `LICENSE`, and a `CHANGELOG.md` beside release-please
Each file named as its kind is: kebab-case pages, workflows and scripts, snake_case modules, `NNNN-title.md` records
No word a glossary marks `_Never_`, the organization's or the repository's `CONTEXT.md`
At least 90 % of lines covered
A pull request's new lines covered: 95 % for `feat` and `fix`, 90 % otherwise
A `feat` or `fix` that changes product code touches a test
A pull request past 400 changed lines is reported
A pull request title is a Conventional Commits header, as the commit hook reads one
A head branch is `<type>/<name>` in lowercase kebab-case, or a bot's
One version per crate, crates.io only, no yanked or unmaintained crate
Every dependency has a cargo-vet audit, from six imported audit sets
A declared benchmark rises by 5 % of its instructions at most
